Privacy and permission: people, documents and tenants

A walkthrough can show everything the camera saw. Clear the rooms first, and have permission for both the capture and publishing it.

  1. Before you capture, ask people and pets to leave the room, and check mirrors for reflections of anyone, including you.
  2. Put away documents, mail, photos, keys, medicines and valuables, and turn off screens.
  3. Get permission from whoever controls the home. If someone lives in it, such as a tenant, get the occupants’ agreement as well as the owner’s.
  4. Before sharing, walk the whole walkthrough and tick the privacy check: people, documents, screens and excluded areas have been checked.
  5. Approve only with both permissions: to capture the home, and to publish and share this exact walkthrough.

Veylet cannot give legal advice. The rules for rented homes and personal information depend on your state and your agency, so check with your agency or a legal adviser. How Veylet handles captures and your details is in the privacy notice.

If it doesn’t work

Found something private after sharing? Pause sharing straight away (see pause or turn off sharing), then email Veylet support with the listing’s name.

To have a walkthrough or capture removed, email Veylet support from the address on your account.

Still stuck? Email Veylet support

Write to yoda@yodalai.xyz and a person replies. Say which step you were on, your iPhone or iPad model, and the app version from Account, then About. Never send passwords or sign-in links.
